summary: Baseline + spec review finds numbered markers must plug into the same exhaustive Item/Tool switch mesh as text, reuse frozen open-zoom text sizing (not live magnification or fixed screen pixels), keep next-number as non-serialized session state with careful undo/delete/reopen rules, and treat Cmd+C/V as region raster paste rather than object paste. Old PNG reopen stays compatible if Kind decode stays additive; unknown marker types still fail whole editor-state restore.
findings: Text size scaling (must share): EditorCanvasView.defaultTextFontSize = round(38.4 / max(0.01, textCreationZoomFactor)); textCreationZoomFactor is set once via setInitialTextZoomFactor(defaultUserZoomFactor) at editor open (EditorWindowController ~804), not updated on zoom. fontSize is stored in canvas points and used by EditorImageRenderer.drawText/textBounds and export compositing (baseImagePixelScale), so markers must derive diameter/numeral size from that same CGFloat (or extract a shared helper). Do not size markers in live NSScrollView magnification or fixed screen pixels.

Multi-digit growth: textBounds uses measured glyph size with mins (60×28) and textPadding (6×4). Markers must grow circle/hit/export bounds with digit count; clipping will fail exportBounds/updateCanvasSizeIfNeeded/hit tests. Safety estimate for text is crude (count*fontSize × 1.5*fontSize) in EditorCanvasState.Item.estimatedCanvasBounds — marker estimate must cover filled circle + outline or isSafeToRestore can wrongly reject large/edge markers.

Event handling: EditorTool currently pen/line/arrow/rectangle/ellipse/text/selection. Add .numberedMarker (or similar) to toolKeyCodeToTool with kVK_ANSI_F (spec: F, not N), toolbar makeToolButton tooltip "Numbered marker (F)", and every tool switch in mouseDown/Dragged/Up/draw preview/setTool. Placement should be click-commit (not drag-shape). Double-click edit should mirror text’s beginEditingText path; keep Cmd+Z routed to NSTextView while editing (EditorWindow only intercepts when firstResponder is EditorCanvasView).

Exhaustive Item switches that break compile/runtime if missed: EditorDrawing.Item; EditorImageRenderer.draw/bounds/shiftedItems; EditorDrawing.Item.stateItem + init(stateItem:); EditorCanvasView.moveItem/hitTest/draw selection; EditorCanvasState.Item Kind encode/decode + isSafeToRestore + estimatedCanvasBounds. Selection uses hitTestEditableItem (reversed) + moveItem + deleteSelectedItemIfNeeded — markers must be selectable/movable/deletable there.

Cursor preview: baseline editor has no custom annotation cursor preview (mouseMoved only stores lastMousePoint; NSCursor customization exists in SelectionOverlay, not EditorCanvasView). Spec’s “if practical with existing cursor infrastructure” means skip heavy custom cursor unless a tiny reuse path exists — avoid inventing a parallel preview system.

Serialization compatibility: EditorCanvasState.Item.Kind is a closed String enum; unknown type fails JSONDecoder → PNGMetadata.decodeEditorState returns nil → reopen loses editability but flattened pixels remain (README already documents this). Old PNGs without markers decode fine if new case is additive. version defaults to 2 with no observed gate. Persist number + color + origin + size (reuse text’s fontSize field or equivalent); do not persist next-placement counter in editor state unless intentionally designed — reopen rule is continue beyond existing max.

Copy/paste: Cmd+C/X/V are selection-region operations (selectedRegionPayload / cutSelectedRegion / pasteCopiedSelection → .image). Markers inside a region become baked pixels in the pasted image, not first-class markers. Object select/move/delete is separate. Extending “paste behavior” means not breaking region paste/clampedRectToImageBounds and ensuring marker hit-testing doesn’t steal selection-tool region drags incorrectly.

Undo: items snapshots only (pushUndoSnapshot). nextNumber must be separate session state: delete must not renumber remaining; switching tools must preserve next; undo of last place should behave naturally (typically remove that marker and allow re-place of same number); clearAll clears items but policy for nextNumber is unspecified in baseline; undo/redo calls resetTransientSelectionState and does not know about counters. Text pattern: push undo on place; cancel empty new item removes without second undo push.

Canvas bounds: updateCanvasSizeIfNeeded and exportBounds union EditorImageRenderer.bounds(for:); ensureDrawableAreaCoversVisibleSize → shiftCanvasContent → shiftedItems (must shift marker origin); placement can sit outside baseImageBounds (text does). Incomplete bounds for multi-digit markers will clip export or fail ImageSafety.canAllocateBitmap growth.

Note footer: baseline NotePanelController footer is shortcut help only; no marker-number UI. Spec’s “existing note footer references marker numbers” means do not add a separate prompt UI — users reference marker numerals in note text.
Docs: README Edit shortcuts omit D/line and have no F; Select docs list object kinds — must include numbered markers.
decisions: Read-only scope limited to work/cursor-agents/numbered-markers/baseline and spec.md; live Sources/Tests not inspected.
Treated “note footer references marker numbers” as product/UX constraint (no separate prompt UI), not missing baseline code — no marker-specific footer found.
Cursor preview called out as optional/low-priority given absent editor cursor infra.
evidence: work/cursor-agents/numbered-markers/spec.md (accepted UX: F tool, text-like sizing, first-class object, no renumber on delete, continue past max on reopen, no separate prompt UI)

open_issues: Exact persisted schema field names / Kind raw value for markers not specified in baseline (implementer choice).

Whether undo of placement must decrement nextNumber vs recompute from max(existing)+1 needs product confirmation; both can satisfy “natural” but interact differently after manual number edits creating gaps/duplicates.
Whether double-click edit is only on marker tool (like text) or also from Select — baseline text requires Text tool.
Hypothesis: cursor next-number preview may be deferred without violating “if practical”.
next_steps: Integration checklist — functions to extend: EditorTool + toolKeyCodeToTool + EditorWindowController.makeToolButton/selectTool; EditorDrawing.Item + TextItem-like MarkerItem; EditorImageRenderer.draw/bounds/shiftedItems/exportBounds path; EditorCanvasState.Item Kind encode/decode/isSafeToRestore/estimatedCanvasBounds; EditorCanvasView.setTool/mouseDown(click place + double-click edit)/moveItem/hitTest/deleteSelected*/pushUndoSnapshot + nextNumber helpers (max-on-reopen, no renumber on delete, preserve across setTool); editableState/stateItem round-trip; README shortcuts + Select object list.

Verification cases: (1) marker fontSize/diameter equals text created at same open zoom for zoom factors 1.0 and ~2.0 via setInitialTextZoomFactor; (2) place 1,2,3 then delete 2 → remaining stay 1,3 and next stays 4; (3) undo last place restores prior items and natural next; (4) switch away/back preserves next; (5) reopen state with markers 1 and 5 → next place is 6; (6) PNG embed/extract round-trip; (7) old state without marker type still restores; (8) multi-digit (10,100) no clip in draw/bounds/exportBounds/updateCanvasSizeIfNeeded; (9) Select hit/move/Delete; (10) region copy/paste still works and does not require object-level marker paste; (11) F selects tool, tooltip Numbered marker (F); (12) double-click edit positive integer, Escape cancel restores; (13) clear/undo/redo do not renumber survivors.
